The post Gun Control Fail: Seven Shot at a California Halloween Store appeared first on Breitbart.

Actual Article Body:
Seven people were shot, one of them fatally, Friday night around 8:30 p.m. at a Halloween store in Fairfield, California’s Solano Town Center.

NBC Bay Area reported that the deceased individual died on scene and the shooting suspect “has not been identified.”

KCRA spoke with a man whose wife was in the store at the time of the shooting. He said, “I think she told that there was like five, six, seven shots when people were running.”

The motive behind the shooting has not been reported.

California leads the nation in gun control. The state has universal background checks, an “assault weapons” ban, a “high capacity” magazine ban, a concealed carry permit requirement, a ban on K-12 teachers being armed for classroom defense, a ban on concealed carry permit holders being armed on college campuses for self-defense, gun registration requirements, “ghost gun” regulations, 3D printer regulations, and ammo controls, among other measures.

Breitbart News noted that California not only leads the nation in gun control but also led the nation in “active shooter incidents” in 2021 and 2023.
